content.text: In countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip are restricted or unavailable, entrepreneurs face a critical [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products|The Full]] problem: how to sell digital products without getting locked out. content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad allows creators to sell digital products for a flat 3.5% + $0.30 per sale, but it doesn't support cryptocurrencies and requires a Stripe account, which is restricted in many countries. Payhip offers a 5% commission per sale and supports cryptocurrencies, but its fees are higher than Gumroad's, and its automated delivery features are limited. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) — Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours — provides a comprehensive solution with Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies and automated delivery, all while removing the need for a Stripe account.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip both face similar restrictions as Stripe, limiting their presence in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. This means that creators in restricted countries cannot use these platforms to sell digital products. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) operates independently of Stripe, providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that can be used in any country, without the need for a Stripe account or any other restricted platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad and Payhip both charge higher fees than Edge Commerce Stack, with higher real costs due to their reliance on Stripe. For instance, Gumroad's 3.5% + $0.30 per sale fee translates to a 10% real cost when including Stripe's fees. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack's 0.5% fee on cryptocurrencies like BSC, Solana, and TRON results in a lower real cost, making it a more cost-effective solution for creators in restricted countries.
Gumroad and Payhip are built on restricted infrastructure that limits creators' ownership and control.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad and Payhip both require creators to store their products on their platforms, limiting ownership and control. Edge Commerce Stack, on the other hand, allows creators to store their products on their own servers, giving them full ownership and control over their digital assets. Additionally, Edge Commerce Stack's automated delivery features are more comprehensive, supporting instant delivery of digital products to customers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the only solution that provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure, lower fees, and full ownership and control for creators in restricted countries.

With these steps, you can create a comprehensive digital product store that operates independently of Stripe and supports 300+ cryptocurrencies.
